family.description: x32: X32/M32 family (docs/protocols/x32.md). xair (v0.2): X Air / M Air family, XR12, XR16, XR18, X18, MR12, MR18 including V2 units (docs/protocols/xair.md). wing (additive, family only; status in development until hardware verification): Behringer WING, WING BK, WING Rack, WING Compact over the native protocol on TCP 2222 (docs/protocols/wing.md). Inputs ch 1..40, main = main 1 (mains 2..4 not modelled), DCAs 1..16, mute groups 1..8 (a strip's mute-group membership is unknown, item 11, so strips report none), DCA membership from #D1..#D16 tags (empty while the console's DCA-mute preference /cfg/dcamgrp is off, because a DCA mute then silences nothing). Headamp index: local n is n (8 on WING, 24 on Rack and Compact), AES50 A n is 100 + n, AES50 B n is 200 + n (read-only, X32 rule); Gain law from the console's own definition. The TCP remote lock makes every set ERR_UNSUPPORTED. faderLaw wing is the x32 display law (WING writes dB, WG-F60).

host.description: Console IP address (IPv4 or IPv6 literal, no hostname).

port.description: Omitted: the family default (x32: 10023, xair: 10024, wing: 2222).

safety.description: v0.3, phone safety (docs/design/phone-safety.md). Defaults for every client of this engine; setSlipGuard and setShowMode change them at run time without a write.

slipGuard.description: Deprecated in v0.5 (slip guard retired, redesign CC-1, SR-26): accepted and ignored; removed in v0.6.

showMode.description: SR-27: the UI restores the per-console setting it stored on the device. With showModeLock (v0.5) show mode is on whatever this says.

monitorCeiling.description: SR-28, CR-25: this engine is a monitor seat. Every level write (fader, and v0.4 send level) is capped at the engineer's latest value + headroomDB (0..10, default 6), never below that value; 'off' or absent: no ceiling; null is refused (ERR_INVALID_CONFIG). v0.4: a monitor role (role) carries its own ceiling per bus, which wins for the sends into that bus and its fader. The hub will carry it per client in the pairing token.

pinRecord.description: The record the Gesture result of lockShowMode returned, stored as is (opaque: a salted PBKDF2-SHA256 hash of the PIN, never the PIN). A record the core cannot read is ERR_INVALID_CONFIG.

showModeLock.description: v0.5 (redesign CC-12, CR-31, README rule 16): show mode is locked on by the owner's PIN for this console on this device. Absent: not locked.

role.description: v0.4, roles enforced below the UI (docs/product/roles.md, invariant 4): the role of every client of this engine (a hub sets one per paired device with the Go call SetClientRole). Absent: owner, the device user on a direct connection. owner and engineer: every write the core offers. monitor: only sends (sendLevel, sendOn, sendPan) into the listed buses and those buses' fader and mute; a write that acts on both buses of a pair needs both in the list (ERR_ROLE otherwise): any write into a linked pair (the console may copy it to the partner, x32.md X32-F81 item 25) and the x32 send pan, which belongs to the pair whether linked or not (X32-F84); a link made at the console re-checks the roles at once and ends holds the seat may no longer move (holdCancelled, reason role). viewer: no write at all. Anything else is ERR_ROLE and writes nothing; settings that only change this device (setSlipGuard) stay allowed, show mode and Gain unlocks are ERR_ROLE for monitor and viewer. Reads are not filtered in the in-process API (the app draws only its mix); per-client filtering is a hub requirement.

buses.description: monitor only, required for it: the buses this seat may write, each once.

monitorCeiling.description: SR-28: the monitor ceiling of this bus for its sends and its fader ('My level'): the engineer's latest value + headroomDB (0..10, default 6), never below that value; 'off': none. Absent: the default, 6 dB (on for monitor seats, phone-safety.md 7).

fx.description: v0.4: this grant may reach an FX send master (snapshot bus kind fx, xair FX 1..4 = buses 7..10). Without it a monitor seat writes only into mix buses: a write into an FX bus is ERR_ROLE (review Sec L3).

favourites.description: v0.5 (redesign CC-7): the favourites layer the app stored for this console on this device, restored at Start.
